title: Local Access
description: Account-free local root SSH and owner-controlled key pairing, independent of LG account authentication.
disableDescription: Stops this module's SSH and pairing servers, which can disconnect sessions using port 9922. Saved preferences, unrelated keys and independent recovery listeners are retained. Keep another working recovery connection first.
publisher: Unknown Digital and Unknown Suite contributors
permissions: Runs as root; declarations are not a sandbox
Starts/stops its owned Dropbear listener on port 9922 and optional key server on port 9991
Maintains its own key entry but preserves unrelated authorized keys and independent recovery listeners

status.title: View current status
status.description: Shows requested and running states for SSH and the pairing-key server, ports and missing dependencies. The private pairing passphrase is omitted here.

health.title: Check module health
health.description: Checks that each requested local-access service is running. It does not test an actual login from another device or certify your network's security.

maintenance.title: Reapply saved settings
maintenance.description: Starts this module's SSH or pairing server only if that service is saved as ON but is not running. It does not renew an LG session or enable a service saved as OFF.

setService.title: Apply local access setting

enumDescriptions.ssh: Allows a paired computer on your LAN to log in as unjailed root. Turning it off can disconnect that session; preserve independent recovery access.
enumDescriptions.keyserver: Serves an encrypted private key on your LAN for pairing. Enable it only while adding a trusted computer, then turn it off. Already paired SSH access still works.

enabled.title: Requested service state
enabled.description: ON starts the selected service and keeps it enabled. OFF stops it and prevents this module from automatically restarting it.

setService.description: Starts or stops only the selected service owned by this module. Another service already using its port is not forcibly stopped.

confirmation.message: Confirm disconnecting SSH sessions using this module's port 9922.

showPairing.title: Show private pairing information
showPairing.description: Shows the TV address, ports, encrypted-key download address and private passphrase for pairing a trusted computer. Do not share or stream this screen.
